lines.text: I still see your face and it tears me open
Every memory feels like a wound reopened
You were stolen from me in a second of carelessness
And I am left here drowning in the emptiness
I scream your name into the dark
But the dark never answers back
Layla… I am furious you are gone
Layla… this pain just goes on and on
I hate the world that took you away
I hate that I’m the one who had to stay
I blame the one who did this, I blame the sky
I blame every god that watched and didn’t try
There is no comfort, there is no grace
Just this rage that won’t leave your empty place
I scream your name into the dark
But the dark never answers back
Layla… I am furious you are gone
Layla… this pain just goes on and on
I hate the world that took you away
I hate that I’m the one who had to stay
I want to destroy everything that let you die
I want to burn the day that said goodbye
There is no lesson, there is no light
Only this fury that eats me alive every night
Layla… I am furious you are gone
Layla… this pain just goes on and on
I hate the world that took you away
I hate that I’m the one who had to stay
